title: Light Yagami Laugh
blurb: A teenager has just confirmed that his absurdly elaborate plan worked, and he cannot physically keep it inside any longer. Light Yagami's laugh from Death Note is the definitive anime villain cackle. It escalates gorgeously, starting as a smug private chuckle and ending in full theatrical howling, and for the better part of fifteen years it has been pasted over every smug reveal on the internet. Keep it loaded for the moment your own ridiculous scheme finally comes together. Nobody deserves to hear it more than the people you were plotting against.
origin: Light Yagami's triumphant laugh from Death Note.

es.title: Risa de Light Yagami
es.origin: La risa triunfal de Light Yagami en Death Note.
es.blurb: Un adolescente acaba de confirmar que su plan absurdamente elaborado funcionó, y ya no puede guardárselo físicamente. La risa de Light Yagami en Death Note es la carcajada de villano de anime definitiva. Escala de maravilla. Empieza como risita privada y presumida y termina en aullido completamente teatral. Lleva casi quince años pegada encima de cada revelación presumida de internet. Tenla cargada para el momento en que tu propio esquema ridículo por fin encaje. Nadie merece oírla más que la gente contra la que estuviste conspirando.
